name: aster-map-v15
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production equirectangular world texture for a rotatable fictional globe in an arcade downhill skate game. Draw a complete fictional planet, NOT Earth, as an uninterrupted 2:1 rectangular flat latitude-longitude map, whole north pole along top edge, south pole bottom edge, left/right edges seamless deep ocean. Rich hand-painted pixel art map with crisp small pixel clusters at consistent density. Four large irregular continents and islands: western midlatitude alpine peninsula with snowy mountains, dark pine forests, huge turquoise inland lake and tiny amber settlements; southeastern warm coastal volcanic archipelago with terraced green hills; eastern midlatitude grassy mountainous land with a few tiny dense harbor cities; northern subpolar continent of rugged cold peaks and fjords. Dark midnight-teal ocean, narrow bright teal shallows, indigo mountain shadows, muted olive woods, warm ochre plains, pale ivory peaks. Visible relief drawn with sunset rim highlights from upper left. No letters, names, typography, UI, borders, compass, grid or frame. Natural coherent coastlines and mountain ridges, dense premium illustrated arcade quality, no blur, no low-poly look. Rectangular FLAT MAP to wrap onto a sphere, do not draw a globe or circular planet.
